values.name: accuracy
values.definition: Flower distributed evaluate weighted mean by client test sample count; all three clients evaluated the same 1192-sample global test set

values.name: f1
values.definition: Flower distributed evaluate weighted mean by client test sample count of client F1 values; not F1 computed from one global confusion matrix; all clients used the same global test set

values.name: bce_loss
values.definition: Flower distributed evaluate weighted mean by client test sample count; each client value is the unweighted mean of BCELoss batch means, so the shorter final batch is over-weighted

resources.measurement_scope: total process wall-clock duration from time.txt; not training-only
